summary: Columbus County, NC: a steel tower reported erected in 1931 (100 ft) and described in 1942 (about 110 ft); the sources disagree and none describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Only two sources, both about the same tower, and they disagree: 100 ft and 2 miles SE of Nakina (1931 report as quoted on the Forest Lookouts index) versus about 110 ft and 0.6 mile S (1942 CGS). facts.height_m is left out until this is settled. Nothing in the cache describes staffing, fires, status or access, and the NGS datasheet has no later history. WebSearch budget was used up in this run, so no newspaper or NC Division of Forest Resources page was checked. A 2026 datasheet retrieval is not evidence that the tower stands. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the advice to ask the NC Division of Forest Resources before going and not to climb any tower was removed, because the Forest Lookouts index does not say it.
